Charlotte, NC | (704) 555-0119 | catherine.vance@example.com |

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Operations executive with 18 years in industrial manufacturing, the last seven running
multi-plant operations of up to 1,400 people. I turn around underperforming plants, build
leadership teams that stay, and connect the shop floor to the numbers the board cares about.
Most recently led a $40 million modernization that raised on-time delivery from 81% to 96%.
CORE SKILLS
• Operations: Multi-plant leadership, lean manufacturing, plant turnarounds
• Finance: P&L ownership to $310 million, capital planning, cost reduction
• People: Building leadership teams, union relations, safety culture
• Growth: New product launches, capacity expansion, acquisition integration
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Harrowfield Pump Company Charlotte, NC
Vice President of Operations Jan 2019 – Present
• Lead three plants and two distribution centers with 1,400 employees and a $310 million
operating budget, reporting to the CEO
• Planned and delivered a $40 million modernization across all three plants on schedule and
$2.3 million under budget
• Raised on-time delivery from 81% to 96% and cut warranty claims by 38% over four years
• Brought the recordable injury rate from 4.1 to 1.6 by putting safety walks and near-miss
reporting at the center of every plant meeting
• Rebuilt the plant leadership team, and every manager hired since 2020 has stayed
• Integrated an acquired valve business into our operating system in nine months, keeping
every major customer and all of its 120 employees
Ironbriar Equipment Works Greenville, SC
Plant Director Mar 2014 – Dec 2018
• Ran a 600-person plant making hydraulic components for construction equipment, with
annual output of about $140 million
